data.title: Choose the sentence that uses the word correctly.

sections.title: cooking
sections.question: cooking
sections.summary: the activity or skill of preparing and making food

senses.definition: the activity or skill of preparing and making food
examples: She loves cooking and often tries new recipes at the weekend.
He is very good at cooking and makes all the meals in the house.

answers.answer: She loves cooking and often tries new recipes at the weekend.
He does cooking every morning to keep fit and build strong muscles.
She went cooking in the mountains last weekend with her friends.
He uses cooking to travel from his house to the office every morning.

sections.title: dancing
sections.question: dancing
sections.summary: the activity of moving your body to music in a rhythmic way

senses.definition: the activity of moving your body in a rhythmic way, usually to music
examples: She loves dancing and goes to salsa classes every Tuesday evening.
Dancing is a great way to keep fit and have fun at the same time.

answers.answer: She loves dancing and goes to salsa classes every Tuesday evening.
He uses dancing to travel quickly between cities for his work.
She goes dancing at the river to catch fish at the weekends.
He does dancing in his garden every Sunday morning to grow vegetables.

sections.title: fishing
sections.question: fishing
sections.summary: the sport or activity of trying to catch fish

senses.definition: the sport or activity of trying to catch fish, usually using a rod and line
examples: He goes fishing at the river every Sunday morning with his father.

answers.answer: He goes fishing at the river every Sunday morning with his father.

sections.title: gardening

sections.title: hiking
sections.question: hiking
sections.summary: the activity of going for long walks in the countryside or mountains

sections.title: music
sections.question: music
sections.summary: sounds arranged in a pleasant way, or the activity of creating or performing these sounds

senses.definition: sounds arranged in a pleasant or interesting way, or the activity of creating and performing these sounds
examples: She listens to music every evening while she cooks dinner.
He plays music in a band and performs at local concerts.

answers.answer: She listens to music every evening while she cooks dinner.
He eats music for breakfast every morning before school.

He plants music in his garden to help his flowers grow better.

sections.title: painting
